s: Shehabbekorot mitannin beereb pesach ubo t' seipim: nohagin habbekorot lehitannot ulehashlim bekol ereb pesach, zeker lannes shennitztzolu mimmakkat bekorot. Umitannin apillu habbekor meab bilbad o meem bilbad, shebbekullam hayeta hammakka, shekkullan niqrain bekorot, habbekor meab niqra bekor lenachala virushsha, vehabbekor meem niqra bekor leinyan pidyon habben. Veap bekor meem shehu kohen o levi, sheeno niqra bekor leinyan pidyon habben, shehare hu patur mippidyon — ap al pi ken tzarik lehitannot, shemmikkol maqom bekor hu ella shehattora petarto mippidyon:

Ishsha shehippila nepel veachar kak yolda ben qayyama, ap al pi sheoto habben eno niqra bekor leinyan pidyon, shehare eno "peter rechem", shekkebar niptar rachmah, mikkol maqom, hare hu bekor leinyan nachala, vetzarik lehitannot. Lepikak im nolad leab zeh ben qayyama kebar meishsha acheret, veim ken ben zeh eno bekor lo lenachala velo lepidyon — en tzarik lehitannot:

Yesh mi sheomer sheggam hanneqebot bekorot mitannot, sheggam bahem hayeta hammakka. Veen nohagin ken bimdinot ellu. Veken bebattim sheen bahem bekor — en gedole habbayit mitannin, ap al pi sheggam bahem hayeta hammakka. Dekevan sheiqqar taanit habbekorot eno ella minhag — lo nahagu lehachamir kol kak, mippene sheiqqar hahatraa vehammakka hakketuba battora beperush — lo hayeta ella al habbekorim hazzekarim:

Nohagin shehaab mitanneh tachat beno habbekor kesheadayin hu bekor qatan, ad sheyyigdal veaz yitanneh hu beatzmo. Umi sheyyesh lo shene banim qetannim ushenehem bekorot, harishon hu bekor leabiv vehashsheni bekor leimmo — hare taanit haab ola bead shenehem:

Vekol zeh kesheen haab bekor, abal im hu bekor vetzarik lehitannot bead atzmo — en taanito ola bead beno, ella haem mitanna tachat benah haqqatan ad sheyyagdil. Veyesh omerim sheen haem tzerika lehitannot, shettaanit haab ola gam bead beno, kevan shettaanit zeh eno ella lezeker lannes, vezikkaron echad oleh lekan ulekan. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bimqom tzaar, vekol shekken im hi meubberet o meniqa. Veap im en lah baal sheyyitanneh bead beno — enah tzerika lehitannot im hi meubberet o meniqa veyesh lah tzaar min hattaanit. Veken yoledet kol sheloshim yom, ap sheen lah tzaar. Umikkol maqom, im hitannet kebar paam achat bead benah vehaya az bedatah linhog ken leolam ad sheyyigdal benah — hare taanit zeh aleha keneder, vetzarik lehattirah al yede sheela vacharata:

Habbekorot omerim "anenu" be"shomea tepilla" bitpillat hammincha. Veim asara bekorot mitpallelin beyachad veechad mehem sheliach tzibbur — machazir hattepilla yomar "anenu" be"shomea tepilla", kedin taanit yechidim. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tob shello yihyeh habbekor sheliach tzibbur kesheasara bekorot mitpallelin yachad, ki yesh omerim sheen nakon lehazkir hattaanit betzibbur bachazarat hattepilla, kevan shehu chodesh nisan, ayyen siman tk"t:

Im chal ereb pesach beereb shabbat — mitannin habbekorot bo bayyom. Abal im chal beshabbat — nidcheh leyom Hashem shellepanayv. Veim qasha lahem hattaanit beyom h', kevan shebballayla bodeqin et hechametz, veen rashshain lisod qodem habbediqa, veyesh lahem harbeh chadarim libdoq — yekolim litom meat qodem habbediqa, shello aseru ella seuda (veshiur teima, ayyen siman rl"b), o yetzavvu leacher libdoq vehem yoklu:

Bemaqom sheen sham minhag yadua — yekolin habbekorot leekol al seudat mitzva. Umikkol maqom, hammachamir — tabo alayv beraka. Abal bimdinot ellu kebar nahagu lehachamir. Lepikak, mi sherotzeh leekol al seudat mitzva — tzarik lehattir lo al yede sheela vacharata, dekevan shehitanna paam achat beereb pesach vehaya az bedato linhog ken leolam, ap sheaz lo hayeta seudat mitzva bair, mikkol maqom min hassetam hitanna al daat hamminhag, vekevan shehamminhag hu shello leekol al seudat mitzva, im ken naasa zeh hamminhag alayv keneder, kevan shehaya az bedato linhog ken leolam. Vehammachamir shello leekol ap al yede sheela vacharata — tabo alayv beraka. Abal baale habberit, dehaynu hammohel vehassandaq vaabi habben, kevan sheyyom tob shellahem hu — yekolin leekol (ap belo sheela vacharata), al yede sheyyalvu hattaanit veyipreu taanit acher leachar happesach, (o yattiru hanneder) al yede sheela vacharata. Umi shemmitanneh bead beno, ap sheeno mibbaale habberit — yakol leekol al hammila al yede sheela vacharata:

Mi shehu istenis kol kak sheim yokal bayyom lo yukal leekol ballayla matztza leteabon — yesh lo lehitannot beereb pesach, kede sheyyokal matztza leteabon ballayla, leqayyem mitzvat "baereb toklu matztzot" leteabon:
